caption: Three families of micro actuator. Piezoelectric strain is about 0.1%, shape memory alloy strain is 4–8% but slow, and an electrostatic plate pulls in after one third of the initial gap has been travelled, leaving two thirds.

spec.aria: A tree with root Micro actuator and three branches: Piezoelectric with 0.1 percent strain, Shape memory with 4 to 8 percent strain and slow response, and Electrostatic with pull-in after one third of the gap has been travelled.
